messages.subject: Tooling APIs finalized and strict configs validated
messages.body: Reconciled configs with current self_audit.volume.config.py strict schema: all 23 configs now omit row metadata and use top-level model/architecture/window/geometry/loss/optimization/training/regions/temporal/prediction_model; REGISTRY.json carries id,parent,changed_factors,status plus V00 historical A0 recipe/hash. Preflight derives id from config filename, calls validate_volume_config, checks forbidden mask/teacher keys, parent acyclicity and emits hashes. Smoke API: volume_smoke.run_smoke(path, requested_steps=None, device_name='cpu', max_seconds=120) -> receipt; calls build_volume_model(config, synthetic=True), model(image, valid_mask), supervised_volume_loss(... mode=config.loss.mode, return_metrics=True). Profile API similarly emits warmup-excluded synchronized rates/VRAM. All 23 strict configs validate; selected V01,V04,V06,O02,R02,T01,C01 synthetic one-step PASS; owned tests 7 PASS; full repo 207 PASS. GPU/real TRAIN NOT_RUN.
